description:
crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/lib.rs has 'pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler;' at line 152, immediately AFTER the body of register_sharing_handlers. The cluster of other pub use re-exports lives at lines 46-65. A reader scanning the public surface of the crate finds:
  - lines 35-44: module declarations
  - lines 46-65: pub use re-exports (8 items)
  - lines 67-150: register_sharing_handlers fn body
  - line 152: 'pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler;' — alone, orphaned

The re-export at line 152 was added so register_sharing_handlers' internal macro can name ClosureHandler without an explicit jmap_server:: prefix. But its placement makes a reader (or a future contributor adding another re-export) think 'ClosureHandler is something different / late / new', when it's just another re-export from the foundation.

Fix: move 'pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler;' into the lines 46-65 cluster, in alphabetic order. Same one-line move in each affected sibling crate.

Marginal-cost finding; bikeshed-shaped but cheap to flag.
notes: Moved 'pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler' from the orphan post-fn position to the main re-export cluster (alphabetic order, immediately after the URI re-exports). Combined with .15's doc addition.
title: pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler at lib.rs:152 is orphaned from the main re-export block
